actions.name: angelic weapons
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s weapon attacks are magical. When the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} hits with any weapon, the weapon deals an extra 5d8 radiant damage (included in the attack).

actions.name: divine awareness
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} knows if it hears a lie.

actions.name: innate spellcasting
actions.desc: The planetar's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: At will: [[/item .Mzh95utKDPIrjiH8]]{detect evil and good}, invisibility (self only) 3/day each: [[/item .dLJhxDfeyOsc3zsY]]{blade barrier}, [[/item .TkJ8Wtg1L7TZtspm]]{dispel evil and good}, [[/item .5e1xTohkzqFqbYH4]]{flame strike}, [[/item .AGFMPAmuzwWO6Dfz]]{raise dead} 1/day each: [[/item .d54VDyFulD9xxY7J]]{commune}, [[/item .ZPd73HtKF3At11jh]]{control weather}, [[/item .OVikYmSdHliAG2YD]]{insect plague}

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: healing touch
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} touches another creature. The target magically regains [[/healing average]] and is freed from any curse, disease, poison, &reference[blinded apply=false]{Blindness}, or &reference[deafened apply=false]{Deafness}.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
